NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 构建数据中心级加速计算平台，整合硬件、软件与算法，赋能AI模型开发与部署。
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Build data-center-scale accelerated computing platform integrating full stack to power AI across industries.

MSFT.name: Microsoft Corporation
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 全面铺开AI技术栈，以负责任方式赋能个人与组织，重点推进智能云与Copilot代理应用。
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Make AI broadly available and responsible, spanning the full stack with focus on intelligent cloud and Copilot agents.

PLTR.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 通过AIP平台整合生成式AI与大模型，赋能企业和政府决策。
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Leverage AIP platform to integrate generative AI and LLMs for enterprise and government decision-making.

META.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
META.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 通过AI助手、智能眼镜和长期研究，打造沉浸式社交与下一代计算平台。
META.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Integrating AI across apps, wearables, and long-term research to build immersive social and next-gen computing.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 多篇文章聚焦于AI编码助手的使用体验、工具版本更新、本地化部署及案例，强调编码agent作为开发者的关键技能。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Articles cover AI coding assistant adoption, tool releases, local usage, and industry case studies.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 涉及LLM的自我改进、扩展法则、推理控制、水印检测、研究论文总结及基准优化等研究性内容。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Focus on LLM self-improvement, scaling laws, reasoning effort, watermarking, and research benchmarks.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 覆盖AI代理的记忆、数据系统、长程交互、具体应用（医疗、科学发现）及代理框架。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Covers agent memory, data systems, long-horizon interaction, and domain applications.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 涉及AI安全评估、源代码安全、数据保留政策、民主监督和量子计算中的错误鲁棒性。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Focus on security evals, source code protection, data privacy, governance, and robust AI.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 关注推理速度优化、嵌入模型、开放模型现状及硬件相关的性能提升。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Covers faster inference, embedding models, open model landscape, and hardware optimization.

alias.notes: Mapped Enterprise AI Platform and 企业数据上的应用LLM to LLM/生成式AI应用 as they refer to applying LLMs in enterprise settings. AI系统可观测性 and Token/成本可观测 both mapped to AI系统可观测性/成本. AI编码agent variants mapped to AI编码agent当硬技能.
